deploy-bot: Deploy started: rolling v2 to 10% traffic across prod (region: us-west, route: /v2/*). Canary window 30m. Logs: https://ci.example.com/builds/9832 :rocket:
sasha: quick question — is v2 still honoring the legacy X-Client-Version header? We had customers on older SDKs that rely on that parsing.
matt: seeing a few 502s from one large customer right after the canary started. stack trace looks like header parsing failure in inference-proxy: `ValueError: invalid literal for int() with base 10`
eva: digging in. I reproduced locally with an SDK that sends `X-Client-Version: 1.0-beta`. v2's strict cast to int fails. Old behavior tolerated non-int.
ben: hmm, that would break a subset of clients. Any quick mitigation? Can we fallback to old parsing when header malformed?
eva: short-term mitigation: add tolerant parse in runtime or route those customers to v1. Runtime patch needs a hotfix build and test — ~45m.
ops-bot: Current canary traffic: 10% (420 req/min). Error rate bumped from 0.4% to 1.8% for customer org ID org-42. Latency unchanged.
sasha: I prefer route pinning for affected orgs rather than rushing a runtime hotfix. Less risk to commit new kernel changes mid-rollout.
matt: agreed. We can pin org-42 and org-87 to v1 by route mapping in gateway. Quick snippet to apply:```json
{
  "match": { "org_id": ["org-42","org-87"] },
  "route": "model:v1"
}```
ben: can ops apply that and pause further canary expansion?
ops-bot: Applying route pins now. patch-id: rp-2026-03-20-17. Rolling update to gateway config.
ops-bot: Done — pins live. Confirmed 0 requests for org-42 now hitting v2.
eva: thanks. I still want to ship a minor runtime tolerance fix, but that can go on the next safe window. For now pause expansion beyond 10%.
sasha: we should also update release notes/compatibility section to call out header parsing behavior and recommended SDK upgrade. I'll draft a short blurb for docs.
caroline: I'll notify customer success and the two affected customers, mention we've pinned them to v1 and will coordinate SDK guidance.
matt: opened a rollback-playbook PR just in case: https://git.example.com/r/redwood/inference/rollbacks/pulls/12 — includes steps to revert rollout and restore previous gateway config.
ben: let's schedule the runtime hotfix for tomorrow's 02:00 UTC change window if no regressions. If we need it earlier, we do full canary and a tightly scoped patch.
sasha: for audit: record decision to pause expansion and pin orgs, cc: @cto.
deploy-bot: Canary expansion paused by request of team lead. Live canary remains at 10%.
ops-bot: creating a short-lived metric alert: when error-rate(org-42) < 0.5% for 60m then we can revisit expansion. alert id: a-1298.
eva: I'll prepare the runtime PR with unit test for tolerant header parsing and link it here once ready.
caroline: notes for release notes: "v2 introduces stricter header validation; certain legacy client versions may need SDK update. A temporary routing fallback to v1 has been applied for impacted customers."
sasha: :thumbsup: good coordination. Post-mortem not needed unless error reappears after pin removal. Marking this thread resolved for now.
deploy-bot: Deploy activity log: canary started 1769451234, pause command issued 1769451389, pins applied 1769451455.
